store.name: Amrutham Restaurant
store.location: TKR Food Court, Gouthambuddha Road, Autonagar, near NRI Hospital, Mangalagiri
store.description:
Amrutham, "The Taste of Andhra", at TKR Food Court, Mangalagiri serves wok-tossed Indo-Chinese noodles and North Indian curries: veg, egg and chicken, all on one menu.

**On the menu**
- Noodles: Hakka, Schezwan, Peri Peri, Maggi masala, Manchurian, Paneer, Kaju, Mushroom and the house special Thecha noodles
- Veg curries: Paneer Butter Masala, Kadai Paneer, Shahi Paneer, Kaju Masala, Mushroom and Babycorn curries
- Chicken and egg: Butter Chicken, Andhra Chicken, Chicken Hyderabadi, Kali Mirch, Afghani and Mughlai chicken, Egg Curry, Egg Bhurji and omelettes

**Good to know**
- Open every day, 12:30 PM to 10:30 PM
- 46 dishes, from ₹40 to ₹230
- Air-conditioned dining room and outdoor seating at TKR Food Court, Gouthambuddha Road, near NRI Hospital

items.name: Egg Noodles
items.description:
Classic Indo-Chinese street-style egg noodles, tossed on a hot wok with egg and crunchy vegetables. A light, savoury plate that is filling and easy on the spice.

Ingredients (Typical):
- Noodles (wheat)
